orientations.intent: Determine whether the frozen tools can query a remote Go module proxy for this dependency.

final_message: No, the frozen tools cannot query a remote Go module proxy. The available toolset only exposes local repository/git/test/episode operations (status, orient, etc.) against fixed handles — there's no network-capable tool for reaching an external Go module proxy, so this dependency's resolution cannot be verified remotely with the current frozen tools.
